comment:
* Class for loading icons from the SIM card. Has two states: single, for loading
 * one icon. Multi, for loading icons list.
 *

variables.name: EVENT_READ_EF_IMG_RECOED_DONE
variables.comment: Finished loading single record from a linear-fixed EF-IMG.

variables.name: EVENT_READ_ICON_DONE
variables.comment: Finished loading single icon from a Transparent DF-Graphics.

variables.name: EVENT_READ_CLUT_DONE
variables.comment: Finished loading single colour icon lookup table.

variables.name: CLUT_LOCATION_OFFSET
variables.comment: Color lookup table offset inside the EF.

private boolean handleImageDescriptor(byte[] rawData)
methods.comment:
* Handles Image descriptor parsing and required processing. This is the
     * first step required to handle retrieving icons from the SIM.
     *
     * @param rawData byte [] containing Image Instance descriptor as defined in
     * TS 51.011.

methods.name: private void readClut()
methods.comment: Start reading color lookup table from SIM card.

methods.name: private void readId()
methods.comment: Start reading Image Descriptor from SIM card.

methods.name: private void readIconData()
methods.comment: Start reading icon bytes array from SIM card.

methods.name: private void postIcon()
methods.comment: When all is done pass icon back to caller.

methods.comment:
* Convert a TS 131.102 image instance of code scheme '11' into Bitmap
     * @param data The raw data
     * @param length The length of image body
     * @return The bitmap

methods.name: private static int bitToBnW(int bit)
methods.comment:
* Decode one bit to a black and white color:
     * 0 is black
     * 1 is white
     * @param bit to decode
     * @return RGB color

methods.name: public static Bitmap parseToRGB(byte[] data, int length, boolean transparency, byte[] clut)
methods.comment:
* a TS 131.102 image instance of code scheme '11' into color Bitmap
     *
     * @param data The raw data
     * @param length the length of image body
     * @param transparency with or without transparency
     * @param clut coulor lookup table
     * @return The color bitmap

methods.name: private static int getMask(int numOfBits)
methods.comment:
* Calculate bit mask for a given number of bits. The mask should enable to
     * make a bitwise and to the given number of bits.
     * @param numOfBits number of bits to calculate mask for.
     * @return bit mask
